intro: I am a B.Tech graduate in Computer Science and Engineering from IIIT Ranchi with strong hands-on experience as a Full Stack Developer. I currently work as a Software Engineer at IndiaMART, where I’ve contributed to high-impact projects like React-NodeJS migrations, SSR, and performance optimizations that significantly improved user experience and site metrics. I’ve also explored Web3, smart contract development, and contributed to blockchain-based applications during my internships. My interests include Blockchain, Web3, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, and System Design — and I continue to explore and grow in these domains.
